_comment: GRI-Mech 3.0: 53 species, 325 reactions. Everything here is read when the program starts - the two names are looked up in method_table.cu and balancer_table.cu, so changing a solver is an edit to this file, not a rebuild.

device._comment: share is how much of the device one run may take: best or half. Give concurrentSystems and batchSize together instead to size it by hand.

controls._comment: the step size controller, used only by a method that takes trial steps - seulex controls its own step and ignores these
